title: NOV Time Business Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The role is accountable for onboarding and supporting the functional tasks required from the system user groups, such as Managers, Employees, Powers Users \& HR to ensure the system is being used correctly and consistently. This will involve creation, update and assignment of training, onboarding materials, communications and user management auditing, to ensure end users are performing their tasks in adherence with policy and procedure.
   

  

 The NOV Time Business Support Analyst will conduct monthly audit activities to ensure timekeeping entries are as required, providing local follow up actions as necessary to address missing items or incorrect utilization as identified. A continuous improvement approach will ensure audit outcomes drive future actions regarding training and communications to mitigate identified issues.
   

  

 The role will work closely with the NOV Time Configuration Team members keeping up to date with systems configuration rules, functional upgrades, new country roll outs and change management, so these can be integrated into the functional end user support activities that the Business Support Analyst provides.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support timekeeping period closure user activities, such as missing approvals and exceptions clear\-outs, against the monthly country payroll calendar.
* Escalate any technical issues observed to the applicable application support teams.
* Performing monthly operational audits of the global timekeeping system, for data integrity and user policy compliance criteria as part of a quality control routine.
* Following up with local HR \& Power Users where audit results and focus areas are identified for monitoring and review, with a view to improving end user compliance.
* Preparing monthly reports \& dashboards on the quality control status for HR Management.
* Maintain and deliver to the timekeeping user groups, the applicable end user training materials, ensuring all users have been onboarded and orienteered in system usage through developing global communications and performing monthly onboarding routines for the various user groups.
* Perform virtual training sessions for HR, Power Users and other business user groups to ensure effective adoption of the system.
* Maintain the global Power User group log for business coverage and change updates.
* Work with the Timekeeping Technical Team as well as HR \& Payroll groups, with the development of the end user training materials to ensure systems utilization is efficient and compliant, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and feedback loops from the operational audits.
* Perform and document external and internal audit controls around end\-user maintenance, liaising with local HR stakeholders as required.


**Qualifications**
* Relevant degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 2\-5 years of experience supporting HRIS, Payroll or Time \& Attendance systems.
* Experience supporting global or multi\-country HR or payroll processes is preferred.
* Experience delivering end\-user training and creating learning materials.
* Experience performing operational audits, reporting and compliance reviews.
* Experience working within a shared services or global HR technology environment is advantageous.
* Fluent English language written \& spoken


**About Us**
 Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
   

  

**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
 Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
   

  

**Global Family**
 We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
   

  

**Purposeful Innovation**
 Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
   

  

**Service Above All**
 This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**ROLE : Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation \& Change**
**Experience** 
 : 7–9 years, including substantial client\-facing L\&D consulting experience
   

  

**Capability profile :** 
 Learning consulting with deployable organisational change management capability
   

  

**Engagement model** 
 : Workstream ownership; proposal solutioning; client\-facing delivery
   

  

**Travel :** 
 India\-based with willingness for short\- or long\-term deployment across KSA, UAE and Qatar
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 The Senior Consultant is a founding delivery and pursuit hire for the growing MENA Learning \& Change capability. The role translates complex client and RFP requirements into practical learning, adoption and capability\-building solutions, then owns key workstreams through delivery.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine Learning \& Development consulting, organisational change management, proposal development, facilitation and responsible AI usage. The role supports MENA priorities, with KSA as the primary growth market and government, energy and financial services as sector priorities. One of the two Senior Consultant vacancies will require demonstrated business\-level Arabic proficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client delivery and workstream ownership**

* Lead discovery interviews, focus groups, learning needs analyses, skills\-gap assessments, stakeholder workshops and design sessions.
* Translate business outcomes into capability frameworks, curriculum architectures, blended learning journeys, facilitator\-led experiences and measurement plans.
* Produce and quality\-review client\-ready strategies, roadmaps, workshop packs, recommendations, dashboards and implementation plans.
* Facilitate stakeholder and learner sessions and present workstream recommendations to client managers and senior stakeholders.
* Coach Staff Consultants and coordinate specialists, designers, facilitators and technology contributors across the workstream.


**Learning transformation and change management**

* Apply instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM to learning journeys, curricula, academies, leadership programmes and capability\-building interventions.
* Develop learning operating model, managed learning services, governance, intake, content operations and performance\-measurement components where relevant.

**Pursuits, proposals and business development**

**AI\-enabled learning and technology**

* Client communication: produces director\-ready documents and communicates confidently in virtual and in\-person settings.
* AI fluency: uses AI to increase speed and quality while retaining human accountability and professional scepticism.
* Builder mindset: creates reusable capability while meeting immediate delivery requirements.

* Demonstrated client\-facing consulting experience and independent ownership of learning or change workstreams.
* Evidence of contribution to RFPs, solution approaches, proposal writing, effort estimation and presentation development.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Practical experience in change impacts, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands\-on use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals or learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline.


**Preferred**
* GCC or MENA delivery or proposal experience, especially in government, energy or financial services.
* Big Four or global consulting experience.
* Experience in managed learning services, learning operating models, leadership development or leadership assessment\-led development.

 business\-level Arabic in reading, writing and speaking is mandatory. The candidate must be able to review proposal content, participate in client discussions, support workshops and interpret business context accurately. Native nationality or ethnic origin is not a requirement.

* One recognised learning credential or structured pathway towards APTD, CPTD or equivalent

* 70% client delivery.

* Staffing and utilisation records.

* Controlled repository and reuse evidence.

* Demonstrate responsible AI use in proposals and delivery and contribute to the learning content generation accelerator or another client\-facing use case.
* Demo, use\-case record or client deliverable.

* Coach assigned Staff Consultants and provide timely, documented review and development feedback.
* Coaching records and work\-product improvement.


**Arabic\-designated role**
* Demonstrate effective Arabic proposal review, client discussion and workshop support where required.
* Practical assessment and engagement feedback.

* Exposure to live MENA learning, change and workforce transformation programmes.
* A role combining workstream delivery, solution shaping, proposal support and capability building.
* A development path across learning consulting, organisational change, facilitation, AI and emerging learning technology.
* The opportunity to shape a growing MENA Learning \& Change capability rather than inherit a fixed operating model.

 As a specialist in electronics and software for the past 20 years, in\-tech is a dynamic, fast\-growing engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany employing around 2350 employees globally across 20 project locations in 8 countries.
 



 in\-tech develops innovative engineering solutions for the automotive, rail, aerospace, defence, and industrial sectors.
 



 We are committed to a flexible, modern work culture and work\-life balance. Our colour orange stands for liveliness, warmth, and dynamism. We value a strong team spirit, fresh ideas and a positive work culture. We call it the “Orange Spirit”!
 



 Since 2024, in\-tech became a subsidiary of Infosys Ltd.This role is responsible for coordinating, delivering, and maintaining training and development programs for freshers and junior team members in the automotive engineering services domain, working closely with German in\-house training teams, project managers, technical leads, and HR. The ideal candidate has 3\+ years of experience in L\&D or HR development, strong communication and organizational skills, and a hands\-on, collaborative mindset within a technical or automotive environment. * Collaborate with in\-house project managers, technical leads, and the HR Business Partner to identify skill gaps and training needs.

* Maintain and update technical and soft skills training modules to enhance the capabilities of team members.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to freshers, ensuring a smooth transition into project roles.
* Track and document the progress of trainees, provide constructive feedback, and maintain reporting on training KPIs.
* Administer and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), including scheduling, enrolment, content uploads, and reporting.
* Stay updated on industry trends and advancements to incorporate relevant knowledge into training programs.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment of training objectives with project requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and report on their impact on employee skills development.
* Support engineering team members with additional training coordination during transitions between projects.
* Handle day\-to\-day administrative tasks related to HR development activities, including training logistics, documentation, and communication with stakeholders.
* Support planning, coordinating and steering all global developmental processes, including talent management, succession planning, leadership development, and performance management.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor's or master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience of at least 3\+ years in a learning \& development, training administration, or HR development role \- ideally within the automotive sector or a similar digital/technical services environment.
* Solid understanding of training coordination processes and HR development practices.
* Familiarity with automotive engineering principles, tools, and technologies is an advantage.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to coordinate and deliver engaging training content for freshers and junior resources with a positive and supportive approach.
* Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and related administrative tools.
* Knowledge of SuccessFactors and SAP would be beneficial but not essential.
* Strong organizational skills with a hands\-on, operative mindset.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a team structure, supporting HR Business Partners and German\-based L\&D leadership on project\-level topics.
* Should be willing to assist in managing all kind of processes \& projects in the HR development field.



  





**Apply with us** 




 If you have experience and team spirit and are looking for a great place to work, then start your job with us.
 



 As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, in\-tech is committed to equal employment opportunity without regard for age, race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

 Workforce Analytics
   

  

 Time Management
   

  

 Operational Support
   

  

 Attention to Detail
